title: IMRaD/section structure parser + per-section indexing
context: A section parser segments articles into typed IMRaD sections with BioC-compatible offsets, improving extraction targeting and grounding. Binding cancer guardrails apply: open-access (PMC OA Subset) / aggregate / de-identified data only; no identifiable patient data; no medical advice; provenance on every assertion. Offsets stay consistent with schema-002.
objective: Build the IMRaD/section structure parser with per-section indexing over schema-002 records.
acceptanceCriteria: IMRaD/section structure parser segments articles into typed sections with BioC-compatible offsets consistent with schema-002.
Per-section indexing improves extraction targeting and grounding; golden fixtures exercised in CI.
Code MIT-licensed; tests + CI green; DCO signed-off.
